description: This file defines a React component for managing global background styling in a Next.js application. It applies or removes a CSS class on the <body> and <html> elements based on the current route to control background visibility, optimizing for visual consistency during navigation.

methods.name: shouldDisableGlobalBackground
methods.description: Determines whether the global background should be disabled for a given pathname. Returns true if the path is '/login' or starts with '/login/'.

methods.name: useIsomorphicLayoutEffect
methods.description: Chooses between useLayoutEffect and useEffect depending on whether the code runs in a browser environment, ensuring correct behavior during server-side rendering.

methods.name: GlobalBackground
methods.description: React component that adds or removes a CSS class on <body> and <html> elements to toggle a global background based on the current route.
